# Source-host pre-FX A/B fixture

These identical one-second48kHz stereo PCM16 files are rendered by the new
adapter and authenticated source-derived FullOracle comparison. They are NOT
recordings of the Apple app, target firmware, or the complete FX chain. The
test compared raw float channel words first (zero differences), then made one
shared PCM16 conversion for listening. No gain normalization was applied.

The12-scene test covers3sample rates x mono/poly x arp-sequencer off/on, real
held-key note-off and release processing. It does not cover the56preset bank.
